what: The CRATE-LEVEL interning ids this body's aggregate types and FUNCTIONS carry in the emitted artifact, keyed by the canonical FIRST-USE index the core module uses.
why: `level_is_zero` is the only chained body that CALLS anything, so it is the only one whose `funcs` lane is non-empty -- and it is the body the 2026-08-20 callee-namespace defect was live in. The emitted text names this body by NAME (`rustcc fn @level::Level::is_zero`) and names its callees by whole-crate INDEX (`call @func.4925`), so nothing in the text says which of those indices is the body itself. Reader A, which reads the artifact binary, can see it; reader B cannot. This table is how reader B is told, and it is the only thing standing between `is_zero(deref(p))` and `deref(is_zero(p))` for a text-anchored reader.
how_it_is_used: `ir_mint::emitted::read_with_self` interns `self_crate_id` FIRST, so the body's own id takes canonical index 0 and a `call @func.4925` reads as a SELF-call at index 0 while `@func.4914` interns above it at 1. `crystal_a2_mint`'s callee-identity lane asserts this table still matches both the emitted fixture and reader A's independent `crate_func_ids_seen` record, and its counterexample test swaps the two ids in the fixture and requires the core modules to DIFFER.
producer_pin: P1/P2 of ir_mint.producer_ab.json (trust `wave-tr-fix` 2026-08-12 and `mfclose` 2026-08-13, binary format v36), which is the build the committed `tests/fixtures/level_is_zero.trust-ir.txt` was taken from. P3 (`lane2rv` 2026-08-19, v37) renumbered the whole crate table: the same two functions are 3895 and 3884 there. The NAMES did not move, which is why the name is recorded next to the id and is the half a reviewer checks.
interface_what: The artifact facts the CORE MODULE cannot hold and the emitted text does print. Same lane as ir_h2.tags.json; read the notes there.

interface.header_note: Absence of a linkage keyword IS `external`; the `rustcc` IS the calling convention. Both are printed by `Display for Function` only when they are not the default. Read the notes in ir_h2.tags.json.

funcs.role: SELF -- the body being read. It is called RECURSIVELY three times (once per payload read), which is why this row is load-bearing rather than ceremonial: without it a text reader cannot tell the recursive call from the call to the deref.

funcs.role: The one non-self callee. Called three times, once per payload read, and its result is immediately consumed by the recursive call -- the dataflow signature `crystal_a1_lineage/level_is_zero.rs` identifies it by.
